CHAP. XXVII. 
 
  Jotham reigns well and prospers, ver. 1-6.   The conclusion of his reign, ver. 7-9.

V. 2. He did-He did according to all that his father Uzziah did; except in his miscarriages.  We must not imitate those we have the greatest esteem for, any farther than we do well; but their failings must be warnings to us, to walk more circumspectly.
V. 3. Built-Repaired it: for it was built before, chap.
